title: Beopack
description: A Texturepack for the server Beocraft. made for the community by That1Squid. (Well only panorama of spawn.)
body:
# The Beopack!!

It adds the spawn of our beloved SMP Beocraft as a background, it also has custom splash text (Mainly stuff said from the community.)

![Beocrafts Spawn.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8zRwyvxT/images/707d1178e9eea833c797982d6f089cdd44e593c4.png)


_made by that1squid <3_




### Credits

to [Fridtjof](https://modrinth.com/user/Fridtjof-DE) who made the [Panorama Screenshot](https://modrinth.com/mod/panorama-screenshot) mod that I used.
